message.content: Mozi argued for **universal love (ren)** as a core principle of his ethical system, advocating that all humans should be treated with kindness and compassion regardless of status or background. He believed this extended to non-human beings too, framing it as a practical way to reduce conflict and promote harmony in society. His idea was rooted in **universal reciprocity**—if you love others, they’ll love you back, fostering a peaceful world. The exact scope of his "universal" extends to animals, but his focus was on human relationships.
